remarks: Welcome to Silvermine Crossing, where this beautifully updated townhome offers the space, privacy and feel of a single-family home with the convenience and warmth of friendly community living.  The open-concept main level features updated flooring, a spacious living room with a wood-burning fireplace, and an updated kitchen with premium stainless steel appliances, newer fixtures and an under-sink water filtration system serving both the kitchen faucet and refrigerator. A sliding glass door opens to a private patio, walkout deck and backyard-an ideal extension of the main living space for dining and entertaining.  Upstairs are two generously sized bedrooms, including a primary bedroom with a custom closet and a second bedroom with a walk-in closet. A Jack-and-Jill full bath serves both bedrooms, and the bedroom-level washer and dryer add everyday convenience. There is abundant closet and storage space throughout.  Recent improvements include a newer energy-efficient heat pump, fresh interior paint, updated light fixtures, ceiling fans in both bedrooms, a smart thermostat/HVAC system and smart electronic entry lock. Central air is in excellent condition.  The unit is the closest home to Silvermine Crossing's beautiful community pool and spacious, recently updated clubhouse, making summer gatherings and pool parties especially convenient.
